items.note: The host now waits up to 30 s for the page to serve; recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.

items.claim: Page script's own error lost behind "never called"
items.note: Same commit as the one above because the code is the same race; each has its own changeset.

items.claim: `MAX_RESULT_BYTES` leaves no room for the CDP message around the result
items.note: The limit now leaves 1 MiB for the message.

items.claim: `dispose()` resolves before a dropped page's browser has closed
`difference` helper compares by byte length only
`NodeRenderArgs` can't name `camera`, `layers` or `pixelRatio`, and they go unchecked in Node
Raw snapshot's own `coords`/`commands` numbers reach the page as typed arrays
items.note: A snapshot holding any typed array is now sent as raw. A raw snapshot with no typed array still can't be told from an old save and is read as encoded; recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.

items.claim: Page whose replacement session never gets a WebGL2 context stays broken
items.note: The page reports whether it can still render, and the host drops it when it can't.

items.claim: `dispose()` can resolve while a dropped page's browser is still closing
`MAX_RESULT_BYTES` bounds only the base64, not the message carrying it
items.note: duplicate of A's limit finding, fixed 068b91f67d.

items.claim: A live scene's data changed on the way to the page
items.note: `sceneToWire` now encodes a live scene's `toJSON()` as it is, with no decode first. A snapshot passed in is still read back first, which the 2026-11-10 ruling covers.

items.claim: A lost WebGL context made every later render fail
items.note: The page draws on its own canvas, checks that canvas's context before and after each render, and replaces a session whose context is lost. The headless package now lists `webgl2` under `weasel.needs`, so the README's package table gained the badge (`check:needs` required it).

items.claim: A page that crashed between renders failed the next render
items.note: The host checks for a crashed, closed or disconnected page before it renders, and opens a new one.

items.claim: A failing cleanup in `open` hid the real error
items.note: A cleanup error is swallowed and the original error is rethrown.

items.claim: `difference` read rasters of different lengths as identical, or gave `NaN`
items.note: It now throws when the lengths differ. It is a test-only helper that doesn't ship, so it has no changeset.

items.claim: A very large render failed with "Invalid string length"
items.note:
The first adds `pixelRenderSize` to core, and `planPixelRender` now uses it, so the size rule lives in one place.
  - The second adds `MAX_RESULT_BYTES` to headless. Node refuses an RGBA render past it before a browser starts; the page refuses an RGBA or PNG result past it with an error naming the limit and suggesting tiles.
  - The two property tests that generated huge requests were adjusted to match.
